1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GlobalMapAgreement
2 
3 /-! Assemble the actual triangle maps into one function on the
4 surface outside the star cuts. Its values there are independent of
5 every triangle, side and edge-orientation choice. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 namespace CutTreeCharts
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
14 
15 theorem exists_developed_point (b : frontier P.body) :
16     ∃ x : Plane, ∃ u v : T.vertices, ∃ edge : T.graph.Adj u v, (charts.global edge).Places b x := by
17   obtain ⟨u, v, edge, x, placed⟩ := charts.exists_global_placement b
18   exact ⟨x, u, v, edge, placed⟩
19 
20 /-- A selected triangle value; values on cut rays themselves are not used for gluing. -/
21 noncomputable def develop (b : frontier P.body) : Plane := (charts.exists_developed_point b).choose
22 
23 theorem develop_spec (b : frontier P.body) :
24     ∃ u v : T.vertices, ∃ edge : T.graph.Adj u v, (charts.global edge).Places b (charts.develop b) :=
25   (charts.exists_developed_point b).choose_spec
26 
27 end CutTreeCharts
28 
29 namespace SixVertexGraph
30 
31 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
32   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
33     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
34 
35 include graph small_faces
36 
37 /-- Every original triangle map agrees with the assembled development wherever it is uncut. -/
38 theorem develop_agrees {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
39     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
40     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) {b : frontier P.body} {x : Plane}
41     (outside : b ∉ P.starCuts a) (placed : (charts.global edge).Places b x) : charts.develop b = x := by
42   obtain ⟨w, z, other, selected⟩ := charts.develop_spec b
43   exact graph.global_triangle_placements_agree small_faces charts cofacial other edge outside selected placed
44 
45 /-- In particular, the restriction to each triangle is its full proved surface homeomorphism. -/
46 theorem develop_on_triangle {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
47     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
48     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (side : Bool) (b : frontier P.body)
49     (inside : b ∈ range (closedRouteStripMap ((charts.global edge).routes side)))
50     (outside : b ∉ P.starCuts a) :
51     charts.develop b = ((charts.global edge).sideTriangle side).homeomorph ⟨b, inside⟩ :=
52   graph.develop_agrees small_faces charts cofacial edge outside ⟨side, inside, rfl⟩
53 
54 end SixVertexGraph
55 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
